## Annotating PDF
Adding an image, text, and signature to a PDF can be challenging. I used multiple gAI chat bots (Claude, Copilot, DeepSeek, and ChatGPT) to create [QuickPDF](https://manabdoli.github.io/quickpdf) in a day.

It is a stand alone app and when downloaded, can be used without the internet.

I hope it proves to be useful.
